chunks.heading: DarlMac Impression — Overview
chunks.text:
DarlMac Impression is known as DMI. It is a Nigerian photography studio founded and led by Macauley Nseh, who is the founder, creative director and lead photographer. The studio turns fleeting moments into printed imagination.

The studio has delivered more than 300 projects over seven years, with an average client rating of 5.0. DMI works out of Uyo, Lagos and Abuja, and shoots weddings, maternity stories, birthdays, editorials and fine-art portraits across Lagos, Uyo and beyond.

DMI's work is recognised for cinematic light, deep skin tones and stillness. The studio blends classical portraiture with a modern editorial sensibility. On a shoot, Macauley directs gently, listens carefully and waits for the half-second when a person finally exhales into the frame.

What the studio promises: industry-level expertise with precision, award-winning creative work, more than 95% of clients achieving better brand recognition and results, and flexible, transparent pricing that delivers value without compromise.

The studio also runs the DMI Photography Academy in Uyo, a three-month immersive programme that mentors the next generation of Nigerian photographers in lighting, business, branding and storytelling. Studio space is available to rent by the half hour.

(End of file)

chunks.heading: Services at DMI
chunks.text: DMI offers photography and film under six headings. Everything can be booked as a session request through this chat.

chunks.heading: Photography
chunks.text: Studio and on-location photography: portraits, weddings, events, maternity, birthdays, graduations, fashion and editorial, product, corporate and family work. Portraits are quoted by location, setting and how many people are in the frame.

chunks.heading: Portraits
chunks.text: Individual, couple and family sessions, shot indoors in the studio or outdoors on location. Portrait prices depend on the city and the setting. Each session comes with edited images, and add-ons like a short reel, extra edited pictures or the full unedited set can be added.

chunks.heading: Videography
chunks.text: Film coverage alongside stills. Weddings can include an extra videographer per event for 100,000 naira, and a drone for 50,000 naira. Portrait sessions can add a 30-second reel for 40,000 naira.

chunks.heading: Events
chunks.text: Event photography for birthdays, launches, corporate days and private parties, shot in Uyo, Lagos or Abuja.

chunks.heading: Studio Space
chunks.text: Self-service studio space in Uyo, rented by the 30 minute slot: a backdrop without air conditioning for 8,000 naira, a backdrop with air conditioning for 10,000 naira, and a content space for 20,000 naira. Props, flower pots and chairs are 5,000 naira each.

chunks.heading: Academy
chunks.text: The DMI Photography Academy in Uyo: a three month programme covering lighting, business, branding and storytelling, taught on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays. It costs 200,000 naira in full, or 100,000 naira in two installments.

chunks.heading: Store
chunks.text:
Digital and print products ship to buyers: Lightroom presets for 8,500 naira, the Posing Guide print book "Printed Imagination" for 5,500 naira, and the mini-course "Photography as a Business" for 15,000 naira.

(End of file)

chunks.heading: Portrait Sessions at DMI
chunks.text: A portrait session is quoted on three things: the city, whether it is indoors or outdoors, and how many people are in the frame.

chunks.heading: Cities
chunks.text: There are three portrait price tiers: Uyo, Lagos and Abuja. Lagos and Abuja share one tier. Ask the client which city they are shooting in first, then indoor or outdoor, then individual, couple or family.

chunks.heading: Uyo portrait prices
chunks.text:
The Uyo session rate is 1 outfit with 3 edited images.

- Individual indoor: 50,000 naira
- Couple indoor: 60,000 naira
- Family indoor: 70,000 naira
- Individual outdoor: 70,000 naira
- Couple outdoor: 80,000 naira
- Family outdoor: 90,000 naira

chunks.heading: Lagos and Abuja portrait prices
chunks.text:
These are session rates.

- Individual indoor: 100,000 naira
- Couple indoor: 120,000 naira
- Family indoor: 150,000 naira
- Individual outdoor: 150,000 naira
- Couple outdoor: 170,000 naira
- Family outdoor: 200,000 naira

chunks.heading: Portrait add-ons
chunks.text:
- 30-second Reel: 40,000 naira
- Extra Edited Picture: 10,000 naira each, maximum 20
- Extra Outfit: charged at the same price as the package
- All Unedited Photos: 15,000 naira in Uyo, 20,000 naira in Lagos and Abuja

chunks.heading: What a portrait booking needs
chunks.text: The booking form asks for the shoot type (portrait, pre-wedding, birthday, graduation, fashion or editorial, product, event, corporate, family), gender, the city, indoor or outdoor, the date and time, outfits, social handles, inspiration links, and any notes. Default start time offered is 10:00.

chunks.heading: Popular portrait occasions
chunks.text:
Pre-wedding, birthday, graduation, fashion and editorial, product, corporate and family sessions all run on the same portrait rate card.

(End of file)

chunks.heading: Weddings at DMI
chunks.text: DMI has a separate weddings feed and an Instagram for wedding work. Wedding coverage is sold as a package, with a one event price and a two event price.

chunks.heading: Packages
chunks.text:
- Pearl: 600,000 naira for one event, 800,000 naira for two events
- Sapphire: 800,000 naira for one event, 1,000,000 naira for two events
- Emerald: 1,000,000 naira for one event, 1,200,000 naira for two events. Emerald is the featured package.
- Diamond: 1,200,000 naira for one event, 1,400,000 naira for two events
- Court Marriage: 100,000 naira, one price
- Introduction: 100,000 naira, one price

A two event wedding is simply the wedding day plus the traditional or reception day. Ask whether the client wants one event or two, then recommend a single package that fits their day and their budget. Do not list every package unless they ask for the full range.

Court marriage and introduction are small, single day ceremonies with one photographer and cost 100,000 naira.

chunks.heading: Wedding add-ons
chunks.text:
- Drone: 50,000 naira
- Extra photographer per event: 100,000 naira
- Extra videographer per event: 100,000 naira
- Backdrops: 70,000 naira
- Content creator: 150,000 naira

chunks.heading: How to price a wedding
chunks.text: Take the package price for the number of events, then add any extras the client chose. The total is the package plus the extras.

chunks.heading: Payment terms
chunks.text: A 70% deposit is required to hold the date and it is non-refundable. The 30% balance is due within 3 days of the wedding. Quote these terms only when the client asks about payment.

chunks.heading: What a wedding booking needs
chunks.text:
Name, partner's name, email, WhatsApp number, wedding date, venue, city, whether it is one event or two, extras, and notes. The chat only needs a name, a WhatsApp number, that it is a wedding and the city to record the request.

(End of file)

chunks.heading: Studio Space at DMI
chunks.text: Studio space in Uyo can be booked by anyone, with or without a DMI photographer. It is rented in 30 minute slots.

chunks.heading: Spaces
chunks.text:
- Backdrop, no air conditioning: 8,000 naira per 30 minutes
- Backdrop with air conditioning: 10,000 naira per 30 minutes
- Content Space: 20,000 naira per 30 minutes

chunks.heading: Studio space extras
chunks.text:
- Extra 30 minutes: charged at the same price as the space chosen
- Props: 5,000 naira each
- Flower Pots: 5,000 naira each
- Chairs: 5,000 naira each

chunks.heading: How a studio space is priced
chunks.text: Multiply the space price by the number of 30 minute slots, then add any extras. For example, two slots of the backdrop with air conditioning plus four chairs is 20,000 plus 20,000, which is 40,000 naira.

chunks.heading: What a studio space booking needs
chunks.text: Full name, WhatsApp number, email if they want one, the rental date, the rental time, which space, how many 30 minute slots, any extras, and notes. Default start time offered is 10:00.

chunks.heading: Good to know
chunks.text:
The space is charged by the half hour, so tell clients how long they think they need before you add up a total. The content space is the one to suggest for short form video and creator work. The backdrop with air conditioning is the comfortable one for longer portrait sessions.

(End of file)

chunks.heading: DMI Photography Academy
chunks.text: The DMI Photography Academy is a three month immersive programme in Uyo for people who want to shoot professionally. It teaches lighting, business, branding and storytelling.

chunks.heading: Batches
chunks.text:
- Batch A: January to March
- Batch B: May to July
- Batch C: September to November

Classes run on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.

chunks.heading: Fees and payment
chunks.text:
- Full payment: 200,000 naira
- Two installments: 100,000 naira each

Payment details are shared by the studio directly.

chunks.heading: What the academy asks for
chunks.text: The application form has five steps: personal details (full name, email, phone, guardian phone, state of origin, date of birth, social handle, and the batch they want), experience level (background, whether they have trained before, and whether they own gear), learning goal, session and payment choice, and terms. There is a guardian phone field, so the academy takes students of school age too.

chunks.heading: Good to know
chunks.text: The academy is only in Uyo. If someone is outside Uyo, tell them that honestly and point them to the studio space or to a session instead. Batches fill up, so if someone is sure, the thing to do is get their name and WhatsApp so the team can follow up on the next intake.

chunks.heading: Recording an academy request
chunks.text:
The chat records a session request the same way for the academy: the person's name, a WhatsApp number, that the enquiry is about the academy, and their city. The team follows up with the application form and the next batch dates.

(End of file)

chunks.heading: Where DMI shoots
chunks.text: DMI shoots in Uyo, Lagos and Abuja. Weddings, portraits and events all travel to those three cities. The studio space and the academy are in Uyo. On social media and in older pages you will also see Lagos and Uyo named together, because those are the two cities the studio built its name in.

chunks.heading: Uyo studio
chunks.text: DMI Studios, #12 Nwaniba Road, Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. This is the main studio. It is where the studio space is rented and where the academy classes hold.

chunks.heading: Phone and WhatsApp
chunks.text: Hotline and WhatsApp: +234-901-396-2323. The chat can send a click-to-chat WhatsApp message to that same number.

chunks.heading: Email
chunks.text: INFO@DMI.COM.NG

chunks.heading: Social
chunks.text:
- Instagram: @darlmac_impression
- Facebook: DMIstudios
- TikTok: @darlmac_impression
- Weddings Instagram: @dmi_weddings

chunks.heading: Opening
chunks.text: Sessions are booked in time slots from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

chunks.heading: How to reach the studio
chunks.text:
Anyone can call the hotline, send a WhatsApp message, email, or start a session request right here in the chat. If a client is ready to book, the fastest way is to leave a name and a WhatsApp number so the team can confirm.

(End of file)

chunks.heading: How booking works
chunks.text: A client fills in their details, a preferred date and the session type. DMI confirms within 24 hours. In this chat, the receptionist collects the same few things and sends the request to the team, who confirm the booking.

chunks.heading: What to collect for a session request
chunks.text:
- What they want to shoot
- Which city (Uyo, Lagos or Abuja)
- Indoor or outdoor, for a portrait
- The date and the time they want
- The package or the studio space
- Any add-ons
- Their full name
- A WhatsApp number
- An email, if they want it written down
- Anything else they want the team to know

Only the name, the WhatsApp number, what they are shooting and the city are needed to send a request. The rest helps the team but should never block a booking.

chunks.heading: Deposits and balances
chunks.text:
For weddings, a 70% deposit holds the date and it is non-refundable. The remaining 30% is due within 3 days of the wedding.

For portraits and studio space, the desk confirms the amount and the team follows up on payment.

chunks.heading: Changing a session
chunks.text: A session can be rescheduled up to 48 hours before it is due, at no extra charge.

chunks.heading: Getting the photos
chunks.text: Edited photos are usually delivered within 7 to 14 working days after the session.

chunks.heading: What the team confirms
chunks.text:
The desk sends the request through so the team can confirm the date, the final package and the total. The receptionist never invents a price that is not on the rate card, and never confirms a date that the studio has not opened.

(End of file)
